verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 3.27
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 3.27

verses.pali: 3. Puggalavagga
verses.english: 3. Individuals

verses.pali: Jigucchitabbasutta
verses.english: You Should be Disgusted

verses.pali: “Tayome, bhikkhave, puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: “These three individuals are found in the world.

verses.pali: Katame tayo?
verses.english: What three?

verses.pali: Atthi, bhikkhave, puggalo jigucchitabbo na sevitabbo na bhajitabbo na payirupāsitabbo.
verses.english: There is an individual you should be disgusted by, and you shouldn’t associate with, accompany, or attend them.

verses.pali: Atthi, bhikkhave, puggalo ajjhupekkhitabbo na sevitabbo na bhajitabbo na payirupāsitabbo.
verses.english: There is an individual you should regard with equanimity, and you shouldn’t associate with, accompany, or attend them.

verses.pali: Atthi, bhikkhave, puggalo sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo.
verses.english: There is an individual you should associate with, accompany, and attend.

verses.pali: Katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo jigucchitabbo na sevitabbo na bhajitabbo na payirupāsitabbo?
verses.english: Who is the individual you should be disgusted by, and not associate with, accompany, or attend?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo asuci saṅkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakammanto, assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño, abrahmacārī brahmacāripaṭiñño, antopūti avassuto kasambujāto.
verses.english: It’s an individual who is unethical, of bad qualities, filthy, with suspicious behavior, underhand, no true ascetic or spiritual practitioner—though claiming to be one—rotten inside, festering, and depraved.

verses.pali: Evarūpo, bhikkhave, puggalo jigucchitabbo na sevitabbo na bhajitabbo na payirupāsitabbo.
verses.english: You should be disgusted by such an individual, and you shouldn’t associate with, accompany, or attend them.

verses.pali: Taṁ kissa hetu?
verses.english: Why is that?

verses.pali: Kiñcāpi, bhikkhave, evarūpassa puggalassa na diṭṭhānugatiṁ āpajjati, atha kho naṁ pāpako kittisaddo abbhuggacchati:
verses.english: Even if you don’t follow the example of such an individual, you still get a bad reputation:

verses.pali: ‘pāpamitto purisapuggalo pāpasahāyo pāpasampavaṅko’ti.
verses.english: ‘That individual has bad friends, companions, and associates.’

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ahi gūthagato kiñcāpi na daṁsati, atha kho naṁ makkheti;
verses.english: They’re like a snake that’s been living in a pile of dung. Even if it doesn’t bite, it’ll still rub off on you.

verses.pali: evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, kiñcāpi evarūpassa puggalassa na diṭṭhānugatiṁ āpajjati, atha kho naṁ pāpako kittisaddo abbhuggacchati:
verses.english: In the same way, even if you don’t follow the example of such an individual, you still get a bad reputation:

verses.pali: ‘pāpamitto purisapuggalo pāpasahāyo pāpasampavaṅko’ti.
verses.english: ‘That individual has bad friends, companions, and associates.’

verses.pali: Tasmā evarūpo puggalo jigucchitabbo na sevitabbo na bhajitabbo na payirupāsitabbo.
verses.english: That’s why you should be disgusted by such an individual, and you shouldn’t associate with, accompany, or attend them.

verses.pali: Katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo ajjhupekkhitabbo na sevitabbo na bhajitabbo na payirupāsitabbo?
verses.english: Who is the individual you should regard with equanimity, and not associate with, accompany, or attend?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo,
verses.english: It’s an individual who is irritable and bad-tempered.

verses.pali: appampi vutto samāno abhisajjati kuppati byāpajjati patitthīyati, kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti.
verses.english: Even when lightly criticized they lose their temper, becoming annoyed, hostile, and hard-hearted, and they display annoyance, hate, and bitterness.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, duṭṭhāruko kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalāya vā ghaṭṭito bhiyyoso mattāya āsavaṁ deti;
verses.english: They’re like a festering sore, which, when you hit it with a stick or a stone, discharges even more.

verses.pali: evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave …pe…
verses.english: In the same way, someone is irritable and bad-tempered.

verses.pali: seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, tindukālātaṁ kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalāya vā ghaṭṭitaṁ bhiyyoso mattāya cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati;
verses.english: They’re like a firebrand of pale-moon ebony, which, when you hit it with a stick or a stone, sizzles and crackles even more.

verses.pali: evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave …pe…
verses.english: In the same way, someone is irritable and bad-tempered.

verses.pali: seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, gūthakūpo kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalāya vā ghaṭṭito bhiyyoso mattāya duggandho hoti;
verses.english: They’re like a sewer, which, when you stir it with a stick or a stone, stinks even more.

verses.pali: evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, idhekacco puggalo kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo,
verses.english: In the same way, an individual is irritable and bad-tempered.

verses.pali: appampi vutto samāno abhisajjati kuppati byāpajjati patitthīyati, kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti.
verses.english: Even when lightly criticized they lose their temper, becoming annoyed, hostile, and hard-hearted, and they display annoyance, hate, and bitterness.

verses.pali: Evarūpo, bhikkhave, puggalo ajjhupekkhitabbo na sevitabbo na bhajitabbo na payirupāsitabbo.
verses.english: You should regard such an individual with equanimity, and you shouldn’t associate with, accompany, or attend them.

verses.pali: Taṁ kissa hetu?
verses.english: Why is that?

verses.pali: Akkoseyyapi maṁ paribhāseyyapi maṁ anatthampi maṁ kareyyāti.
verses.english: Thinking, ‘They might abuse or insult me, or do me harm.’

verses.pali: Tasmā evarūpo puggalo ajjhupekkhitabbo na sevitabbo na bhajitabbo na payirupāsitabbo.
verses.english: That’s why you should regard such an individual with equanimity, and you shouldn’t associate with, accompany, or attend them.

verses.pali: Katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo?
verses.english: Who is the individual you should associate with, accompany, and attend?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sīlavā hoti kalyāṇadhammo.
verses.english: It’s an individual who is ethical, of good character.

verses.pali: Evarūpo, bhikkhave, puggalo sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo.
verses.english: You should associate with, accompany, and attend such an individual.

verses.pali: Taṁ kissa hetu?
verses.english: Why is that?

verses.pali: Kiñcāpi, bhikkhave, evarūpassa puggalassa na diṭṭhānugatiṁ āpajjati, atha kho naṁ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati:
verses.english: Even if you don’t follow the example of such an individual, you still get a good reputation:

verses.pali: ‘kalyāṇamitto purisapuggalo kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko’ti.
verses.english: ‘That individual has good friends, companions, and associates.’

verses.pali: Tasmā evarūpo puggalo sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo.
verses.english: That’s why you should associate with, accompany, and attend such an individual.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasminti.
verses.english: These are the three individuals found in the world.

verses.pali: Nihīyati puriso nihīnasevī,
verses.english: A man who associates with an inferior goes downhill,

verses.pali: Na ca hāyetha kadāci tulyasevī;
verses.english: but associating with an equal, you’ll never decline;

verses.pali: Seṭṭhamupanamaṁ udeti khippaṁ,
verses.english: following the best, you’ll quickly rise up,

verses.pali: Tasmā attano uttariṁ bhajethā”ti.
verses.english: so you should keep company <j>with people better than you.”

verses.pali: Sattamaṁ.
